text:
Devin: Quick check — targeting release cut at 20:00 UTC. Can we run a focused green-sweep on the release branches? looking for flaky test triage, version bump status, and any last infra docs. @Alex @Maria @Sarah
Alex: On it. I bumped the package to `2.7.1` on `release/v2.7` and opened PR #4321. CI queued.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #4321 — https://ci.redwood/in/4321 — queued on linux/gpu and macos runners.
Maria: Changelog updated with quantization runtime notes and a placeholder for marketing blurb. Will add final line after merge. Also: cutoff reminder — ~4h from now.
Sarah: Seeing an intermittent fail on macos: `tests/test_cache.py::test_eviction` — hangs ~30s then times out. Repro local run 3/6 fails. @Alex can we mark as flaky or add additional logging?
Alex: I'll add a macOS skip marker and extra logging. Also rerunning with `--seed=42` to check determinism. Pushing a small patch in a bit.
Devin: If we mark flaky, please file an issue with repro and add it to the flaky-rotation board so it's tracked. Also need a reviewer on #4321 — @ops-luke for infra bump.
ops-luke: Reviewing now. Quick note: dedicated-capacity config bumped CPU requests; did a k8s dry-run, looks good. LGTM aside from one doc nit.
ci-bot: Build update: linux/gpu ✅ green; macos ❌ failing `test_eviction` (7/8 runs failed). Rerun requested by Alex: `/ci rerun 4321 --platform macos`.
Alex: Reran. Short log excerpt: `AssertionError: expected eviction` then `timeout after 60s`. Adding more logging and a small sleep to see if timing quirk helps.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft the release note blurb and attach to the changelog PR once merged.
Devin: Cutoff in ~3h. If tests remain flaky, fallback = pin to last-stable model variant for this release; prefer to keep the change but avoid holiday-risk. Need confirmation by EOD.
Sarah: Filed issue #789 with stacktrace, local repro steps, and marked flaky. Added to flaky-rotation board and assigned to infra for investigation.
ops-luke: Merged infra doc update in #4309; will run a post-merge smoke.
ci-bot: All checks green on `release/v2.7` after marking the flaky test and merging the infra doc. Dry-run deploy passed: https://ci.redwood/dryrun/9876
Devin: Great. I'll notify #releases and schedule the final smoke at 19:30 UTC. Thanks everyone :tada:
